//: Declared inputs of tooling-tests steps the walker cannot read whole (scripts/ci/tooling_steps.py): a shell script
that runs a file from a variable (`for t in tests/*.test.sh; do bash "$t"`), or a run text that names no test.
Without an entry such a step runs on every pull request. With one, it runs when a changed path matches an input glob
(`**` crosses folders) or an input the walker resolved, and is skipped with the reason otherwise. A change to this
file runs every step. `tooling_steps.py verify --workflow W --job J` runs each declared step under strace -f and
fails on a checkout file it touched that neither its globs nor its resolved inputs cover

`"traced": true` (tooling_steps.py load_traced): its globs and the walker's resolved files are every path the step's traced run read (`verify` checks that), so they alone decide it; the walker's folder, whole-tree and spelled-name guesses are not consulted. A feat-cmux-next push is not pull_request, so tooling-tests runs every step there and a read the globs miss shows red on the base; rerun `verify` when a traced step's script changes.

tt-measure-tests.why: run-all.sh runs every scripts/measure/tests/*.test.sh and *.test.py by a loop variable; no-unattended-prompts reads every tracked file under scripts/ and .github/
